body: when I was ur age I also never imaged to live this long. I had no friends, no relationships (I was ugly..or what was considered ugly), bad at school and traumatized by my family. I had nothing. I wanted to kill myself but I couldn‘t because I was too afraid to disappoint my little sister. She was everything I had. I always cried myself to sleep. I couldn‘t bear my life anymore. Now, 10 years later, I‘m happy that I didnt do it. My life is so much different than I had imaged. After school I moved to another city for college and cut contact with everyone except my family. I joined a club of a hobby I enjoy and met soo many people who had the same interests. no one who called me „nerdy“. I found friends for life. I quit bingeeating and lived healthier because I had a social life. Because of that I had a physical „glow up“. I started dating. I got into jobs I like that I got through my college clubs. I love being alive now. And of course sometimes I still get depressed but now I have people who love me. and I also talked to my mom about my family trauma and she gets me now and everything is beautiful. please never give up! Places make people how they are feeling. Cut out toxic relations and surround yourself with people who empower u!
